name: The Accountant
description: Audits a fleet of Grok Bots for the ones burning tokens needlessly — polling too often, stuck in retry loops, carrying bloated usage — and recommends whether to trim, move or shut each one down. Only earns its keep once you're running enough bots that the spend has become noticeable.

official.title: The Accountant by Ben
official.description: Finds runaway-token Grok Bots—over-polling, bloated usage, retry loops—and tells you what to tighten, offload, or kill. For anyone whose fleet is eating...
